blocks.text: Onii Kei (literal 'elder brother style') is a Japanese fashion style that combines American casual, Italian casual, and rocker styles to create a 'slick' look. White tailored jackets, low-necked tank tops, imported jeans, and pointed shoes are commonly featured. A shag haircut known as 'wolf hair' is also a part of this fashion style.
Onii Kei is the male counterpart of Onee Kei (literal 'elder sister style'), which emerged around 1996 and was a sexy, casual style which featured body-hugging dresses and an adult look.
Footwear: Boots and pointed leather shoes.
Bottoms: Imported designer jeans and slim-fit.
Tops: Low-necked tank tops associated with fitted button-downs, or crisp white tailored jackets.
Accessories: Heavily branded watches, statement sunglasses, luxury belts, and subtle jewelry.
Hair: Teased shag haircut also known as "wolf hair," often groomed with scented hair products.
Inspirations: Diffuses Italian casual (Ita-kaji) and American casual (Ame-kaji) with a sharper edge.
Vibe: Sharp, Sleek, and confident, strongly paired with Japanese host clubs in areas such as Shibuya.
Age Group: Worn mostly by men who are in their 20s aging out of flashier teen Gyaruo styles.
Outerwear: Sharp blazers, luxe jackets, and rugged leather pieces.
